# WorldEye

> WorldEye is a live 3D intelligence globe on the web. It puts 74,229 live public cameras from 109 countries, real-time flight and satellite tracking, ships, weather radar, earthquakes and wildfires on one interactive globe. Browsing is free with no account — the free plan includes 5 camera opens on the globe — and paid plans (Pro and VIP Pro) add an AI analyst, camera recording, camera alerts, satellite map view and premium intelligence layers.

## Platform

- [Live globe](https://worldeye.app/): The WorldEye app — a live 3D globe with cameras, flights, satellites, weather, earthquakes and wildfires, free with no signup.
- [Features](https://worldeye.app/features): Everything WorldEye does — the free live layers, the OSINT toolkit, the AI analyst and what Pro and VIP Pro add.
- [Pricing](https://worldeye.app/pricing): Free globe for everyone. Paid plans: Weekly $7.99, Monthly $13.99, annual $74.99 (VIP Pro), Enterprise $999/year. Every paid plan starts with a 10-day free trial.

## Live Cameras

- [Live cameras](https://worldeye.app/cameras): The camera hub — browse 74,229 live public cameras worldwide: traffic, cities, landmarks, beaches, airports and nature.
- [Live webcams directory](https://worldeye.app/live-webcams): The directory hub with per-country counts, how feeds are verified, and the busiest camera networks.
- [Cameras by country](https://worldeye.app/cameras/countries): Live camera pages for 109 countries, each with that country's real camera count, areas and playable feeds. Largest networks: United States (41,355), Japan (10,472), Canada (4,685), Taiwan (3,243), Spain (2,120).
- [City webcams](https://worldeye.app/world-city-webcams): The busiest camera regions and cities in the world, with per-region counts and featured feeds.
- [Live traffic cameras](https://worldeye.app/live-traffic-cameras): Highway and road cameras, including per-country traffic camera guides.
- [Ski webcams](https://worldeye.app/ski-webcams): Live mountain and ski resort cameras.
- [Beach webcams](https://worldeye.app/beach-webcams): Live beach and coastal cameras.
- [Airport webcams](https://worldeye.app/airport-webcams): Live airport cameras and plane-spotting views.

## Trackers

- [Live flight tracker](https://worldeye.app/live-flight-tracker): Real-time aircraft positions from ADS-B broadcasts on the free globe.
- [Live plane spotting](https://worldeye.app/live-plane-spotting): Watch aircraft movements and airport activity live.
- [Satellite tracker](https://worldeye.app/satellite-tracker): The ISS, Starlink and thousands of satellites tracked live.
- [Space station tracker](https://worldeye.app/space-station-tracker): Follow the International Space Station in real time.
- [Ship tracker](https://worldeye.app/ship-tracker): Live vessel positions from AIS broadcasts.
- [Weather tracker](https://worldeye.app/weather-tracker): Live weather radar and conditions on the globe.
- [Earthquake tracker](https://worldeye.app/earthquake-tracker): Earthquakes as they happen — magnitude, depth and location from USGS data.
- [Hurricane tracker](https://worldeye.app/hurricane-tracker): Live tropical storm and hurricane tracking.
- [Wildfire tracker](https://worldeye.app/wildfire-tracker): Active wildfires from NASA satellite detection feeds.
- [Cyber threat map](https://worldeye.app/cyber-threat-map): Live cyber threat intelligence on the map (Pro intel layer).

## Learn

- [FAQ](https://worldeye.app/faq): Direct answers about the free map, the free camera limit, Pro, VIP Pro, camera alerts, trials, billing, cameras and privacy.
- [What is ADS-B?](https://worldeye.app/what-is-ads-b): How aircraft broadcast their positions, and how live flight tracking works.
- [What is AIS?](https://worldeye.app/what-is-ais): How ships broadcast their positions, and how live vessel tracking works.
- [Blog](https://worldeye.app/blog): Guides and explainers on live tracking, cameras and open-source intelligence.

## Comparisons

- [Compare](https://worldeye.app/compare): Side-by-side comparisons of WorldEye with other live-map, webcam and OSINT tools. This is also the alternatives hub — /alternatives redirects here.
- [God's Eye View](https://worldeye.app/gods-eye-view): What a god's eye view of Earth is, and how WorldEye delivers it as a hosted website — free, no install, no API key.
- [God's Eye View alternative](https://worldeye.app/alternatives/gods-eye-view): WorldEye compared with the open-source God's Eye View project — hosted versus install-it-yourself, 74,229 cameras versus roughly 4,000.
